evidence.shows: Protocol website confirms products: XTBT, XMMF, XFTB vault tokens backed by US T-bills and money market funds; EURC MMF vault; Sierra liquid yield token; built on ERC-4626 vault architecture; targets fintechs/neobanks for white-labeled stablecoin yield on USDC, USDT, EURC; Perimeter Protocol fork credited to Circle Research; company is Open Trade Technology Ltd.

Protocol Operator and Vault Admin both identified as Open Trade Technology Ltd. Borrower is OpenTrade SPC (bankruptcy-remote Cayman SPV overseen by FCA-regulated Five Sigma). Contract addresses are NOT listed in docs — text states 'the specific smart-contract addresses associated with the product will be listed and visible through the web app'. Protocol is a fork of Circle Research's Perimeter Protocol, using ERC-4626 yield-bearing vaults with USDC/EURC/USDT as underlying assets.

27 total RWAs catalogued: 20 on Avalanche C-Chain ($111.5M), 3 on Plume ($8.2M), 4 on Ethereum ($112.7K). 92 holders, $22.87M monthly transfer volume. Confirms three chains in protocol.chains. No contract addresses listed.

protocol_metadata.about: OpenTrade is a B2B stablecoin yield infrastructure platform that enables fintechs, neobanks, and exchanges to offer white-labeled yield products on USDC, USDT, and EURC. Users deposit stablecoins into ERC-4626-compliant yield-bearing vaults; the protocol issues vault tokens representing pro-rata claims on the pool. Loans are disbursed to OpenTrade SPC, a bankruptcy-remote Cayman Islands SPV managed by FCA-regulated Five Sigma, which invests in US Treasuries, money market funds, corporate bonds, and trade finance. The protocol is a fork of Circle Research's Perimeter Protocol, maintained by Open Trade Technology Ltd, and is deployed across Avalanche C-Chain (primary, ~$111.5M TVL), Plume, and Ethereum.
